crime_highlights: Mr. M’s vehicle crossed the center lane and collided head on
As a result of the collision, Mr. H. sustained a broken sternum.
rationale_highlights: Mr. M. is of African Nova Scotian decent.
I am cognizant of the over-representation of African Canadians or African Nova Scotians housed within prisons and penitentiaries throughout this province and country.

However, the inequity requires addressing. If we are truly going to tackle the alarming rates of over-representation of racialized groups, it is crucial that we accept the stark reality that status quo of our sentencing system is fundamentally flawed.
when I reconcile the facts of the offence against the horrific background and yet remarkable accomplishments of Mr. M.
However, equally compelling are the unique circumstances of Mr. M.
I conclude this is that unique case, thus warranting this rare disposition.
note: IRCA background and overrepresentation support non-custodial sentence outside range

crime_highlights: Mr. Marshall was the operating mind behind this commercial cannabis trafficking operation
he operated it in a flagrant and open manner
rationale_highlights: imprisonment should, within reason, be seen as a last resort, especially for Aboriginal offenders
a consideration of Gladue factors arising from him being a member of Millbrook that has suffered historic wrongs from residential schools and colonialism
exercising restraint, I find four months, the low end, a fit and proper sentence
note: Gladue listed as mitigating; outweighed for discharge but restraint applied
